title: photo_gallery URL uses /domain/ prefix instead of /media/
description: activitypub.rs:936. In photo_gallery, the image URL is built as format\!("https://{domain}/{}", m.file_path). The file_path already starts with 'media/' (e.g., 'media/ab/12345.jpg'), so the resulting URL is correct: https://domain/media/ab/12345.jpg. But this relies on the file_path having the 'media/' prefix. If file_path ever changes to not include 'media/', the URLs will break. Compare with other locations like posting.rs:1407 which use format\!("https://{domain}/media/{file_path}") — which would produce a double 'media/media/' prefix. The codebase uses inconsistent URL construction patterns for media, making it fragile.
